summary: Sujeet Kumar works in computational Indology. He has held posts at the Indian Institute of Technology Kharagpur and B.P. Mandal College of Engineering.

Suk Fun Ng specializes in Buddhist studies and sinology. Ng earned a PhD at the University of Hong Kong under Jing Yin and Yakupitiyage Karunadasa, also studying under K. L. Dhammajoti, and became a professor at Hong Kong Baptist University.

Sukhen Ghosh works in Indology. After earning a master's at Visva-Bharati University (2019–2021), Ghosh completed a Ph.D. at Mahatma Gandhi Central University in 2022, where he also served as a research scholar (SRF).

Sukhlal Sanghvi (1880–1978) was an Indology and philosophy scholar who studied at Shri Yashovijaya Jain Sanskrit Pathshala and under Balakrishna Mishra. He held posts at Gujarat Vidyapith, Banaras Hindu University as Chair of Jain Philosophy, and Bharatiya Vidya Bhavan.

Sukra Sagar Shrestha (1956–2018) was a scholar in history, archaeology, and Indology. He served as an epigraphist at the Archaeological Survey of India (attested 1986) and the Department of Archaeology (attested 1987).

Sukumar Sen (1900–1992) was a linguist and Indologist who studied at the University of Calcutta under Suniti Kumar Chatterji and Irach Jehangir Sorabji Taraporewala. He lectured at Calcutta from 1930 and became Khaira Professor there in 1954.

Sukumari Bhattacharji (1921–2014) was an Indologist who completed a master's in English at the University of Calcutta and doctoral studies at Jadavpur University. She taught English at Lady Brabourne College from 1945 and taught at Jadavpur University (1957–1986).

Sulagna Bhattacharya works in the field of Indology. Bhattacharya studied under doctoral supervisor Pratap Bandyopadhyay and held an H P Shastri Research Fellowship at The Asiatic Society (attested 2026).

Sulak Sivaraksa (b. 1933) is an author in Buddhist and religious studies who studied at the University of Wales, Lampeter, later becoming an honorary fellow there. He held visiting professorships at UC Berkeley, Harvard, Toronto, and Cornell.

Suman Chakraborty works in computational Indology. After earning an M.Sc. at the University of Calcutta, he was a Ph.D. student at IUCAA, faculty at IACS in 2019, and held a post at IIT Kharagpur (attested 2023).

Sumathi Ramaswamy (born 1961) is an Indologist and historian. She studied at the University of Delhi, Jawaharlal Nehru University, and the University of Pennsylvania, later holding posts at the University of Pennsylvania (1995–2000) and the University of Michigan (2000–2007).

Sumi Lee is a scholar of Buddhist studies. She earned an MA at the University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign under Alexander L. Mayer and a PhD at the University of California, Los Angeles, under Robert E. Buswell Jr.

Sumitra Mangesh Katre (1906–1998) was an Indologist and linguist who earned a Ph.D. at the University of London under Ralph Lilley Turner. He founded Deccan College, serving as Chair of Indo-European Philology, and later taught at UT Austin.

Sun-Ah Choi works in history, archaeology, and Buddhist studies. Choi earned a PhD at the University of Chicago under doctoral supervisor Juhyung Rhi, also studying under Richard Neer, Robert S. Nelson, Jaś Elsner, and Aden Kumler.

Sunanda Mukhopadhyay is an Indologist and linguist who studied under doctoral supervisor Shyam Sundar Bhattacharya. Mukhopadhyay held a position as a research scholar/fellow at The Asiatic Society (attested 2026).

Sunayana Maiti is a scholar of history, archaeology, and Indology who completed a PhD at the University of Calcutta (2014–2021). Maiti has held research fellow posts at The Asiatic Society from 2017 to 2021 and in 2026.

Sung Yong Kang is a scholar of Indology and philosophy. He studied at Seoul National University and the University of Hamburg, and later held posts at the University of Vienna (~2004–2007) and Seoul National University (~2007).

Sung-Bae Park (b. 1933) is a Buddhist and religious studies scholar who earned his doctorate under Lewis Lancaster. He served as an assistant professor at Dongguk University and became Professor Emeritus at Stony Brook University after joining in 1977.
Sung-Eun Kim is a scholar of Buddhist and religious studies. Kim earned a PhD from Seoul National University (2004–2012) and became an assistant professor at Dongguk University in 2020.

Sungdoo Ahn specializes in Buddhist studies and Indology. He earned a PhD from the University of Hamburg under Lambert Schmithausen, served as Director at Geumgang University, and held a professorship at Seoul National University.
